title: Materials from the Earth - 123 school
heading: Materials from the Earth
intro: You learn these terms and calculations by practising. Only use BINAS when the question names a BINAS table.

questions.question: Which three substances are fossil fuels?

answers.c: crude oil, natural gas and coal

questions.question: What is mining?

answers.c: Getting raw materials out of the ground

questions.question: Which metal is found in the ground as a pure metal?
In what form are most metals found in the ground?
What is corrosion?

answers.a: Two metals are mixed to form an alloy
answers.b: A base metal reacts with substances from its surroundings, such as oxygen and water
answers.c: A metal melts because of heat
answers.d: A metal dissolves without any reaction taking place

questions.question: What is corrosion of iron called?
Which substances are needed for iron to rust?
What must be different to separate two liquids by distillation?
With which separation process are the fractions of crude oil separated? (use BINAS table 41)
What is cracking?

answers.b: Joining small molecules into long chains
answers.c: Breaking large hydrocarbon molecules into smaller molecules

questions.question: Which kinds of atoms mainly occur in hydrocarbons?
What is the residue of the distillation of crude oil used for?
What is the density of gold? (use BINAS table 15)
A block of gold and a block of copper (density 8.96 g/cm<sup>3</sup>) of the same size lie side by side. Which block is heavier?

answers.a: the gold, because gold has the larger density
answers.b: the copper, because copper has the larger density
answers.c: they are equally heavy, because they are the same size
answers.d: you cannot know without measuring the volume

questions.question: How many mL is 1 cm<sup>3</sup>?
How many grams is 1 kg?
What are polymers made of?
Which plastic can melt at a higher temperature and be shaped again?
How well do plastics conduct electric current?
What is an alloy?

answers.b: a metal that comes out of the ground
answers.c: a plastic with a layer of metal
answers.d: a mixture of a metal with one or more other substances

questions.question: What is the mass percentage of gold in 18 carat gold? (24 carat is pure gold)
What is a property of noble metals?
Zinc is a base metal, but it is still used for gutters. Why is that possible?

answers.a: zinc does not react with oxygen
answers.d: a thin layer of zinc oxide forms that protects the zinc

questions.question: What does MAC stand for?
What is the MAC value of mercury? (use BINAS table 40)
A bar of 250 g contains 160 g of cocoa. What is the mass percentage of cocoa?
Which separation methods are used to purify water?
Which three types of radiation do you know?
Which measure protects you against radiation?

answers.a: keeping your distance and being exposed for as short a time as possible
answers.d: getting as close to the source as possible
